title: I WASHED MY HANDS
stanzas: I washed my hands this morning ,O, very clean and white, and lent them both to Jesus, to work for Him till night
I told my ears to listen quite closely all day thro', for any act of kindness, such little hands can do
Little feet be careful where you take me too (anything for Jesus) Only let me do.
My eyes are set to watch them, about their work or play, to keep them out of mischief for Jesus' sake all day.
